name: Euphoria
description: A group of high school students navigate love and friendships in a world of drugs, sex, trauma, and social media.

videos.title: Trouble Don't Last Always
videos.overview: In the aftermath of being left by Jules at the train station and relapsing, Rue celebrates Christmas.

videos.title: F**k Anyone Who's Not a Sea Blob
videos.overview: Over the Christmas holiday, Jules reflects on the year.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Seventeen-year-old Rue returns home from rehab with no plans to stay clean.

videos.title: Stuntin' Like My Daddy
videos.overview: On the first day of school, Rue has a new friend, Jules, but struggles to put the past behind her.

videos.title: Made You Look
videos.overview: Kat starts camming. Jules falls for a boy online. Rue is confronted at NA, and Cassie visits McKay at college.

videos.title: Shook Ones Pt. II
videos.overview: Rue, trying to get clean for Jules, chaperones Gia at the carnival. Jules encounters Cal with his family.

videos.title: '03 Bonnie and Clyde
videos.overview: Maddy and Nate must deal with a police investigation. Rue and Jules each reflect on their relationship.

videos.title: The Next Episode
videos.overview: On Halloween, Rue worries about her reliance on Jules when she starts acting strange.

videos.title: The Trials and Tribulations of Trying to Pee While Depressed
videos.overview: Rue gets depressed and watches 22 straight episodes of a British reality show.​ Jules visits an old friend.

videos.title: And Salt the Earth Behind You
videos.overview: It's the winter formal at East Highland.

videos.title: Trying to Get to Heaven Before They Close the Door
videos.overview: Rue and Jules cross paths for the first time since Christmas as East Highland rings in the new year.

videos.title: Out of Touch
videos.overview: As the new semester kicks off, Jules questions Rue and Elliot’s new friendship, while Cal hunts for answers.

videos.title: Ruminations: Big and Little Bullys
videos.overview: Rue pursues a new business venture, Cassie settles into a routine, and Cal finds a target.

videos.title: You Who Cannot See, Think of Those Who Can
videos.overview: Jules and Elliot grow closer, Maddy celebrates her birthday and Cal takes a trip down memory lane.

videos.title: Stand Still Like the Hummingbird
videos.overview: Fate has a way of catching up with those who try to outrun it.

videos.title: A Thousand Little Trees of Blood
videos.overview: Rue tries to recover, Lexi questions putting on her play and Nate celebrates his newfound freedom.

videos.title: The Theater and Its Double
videos.overview: Art imitates life as the East Highland crew watches their complicated dynamics play out onstage.

videos.title: All My Life, My Heart Has Yearned for a Thing I Cannot Name
videos.overview: As the show goes on, fragments of memories collide with the present and future.

videos.title: Andale
videos.overview: A few years after high school, Rue's debts finally catch up with her. Hoping to finance her dream wedding, Cassie tries to become internet famous – to the disapproval of Nate, who's juggling the demands of running Cal's business.

videos.title: America My Dream
videos.overview: Maddy arrived in the city with no money, a suitcase full of clothes, and a plan.

videos.title: The Ballad of Paladin
videos.overview: While in art school, Jules learns she can fund her dreams by going on dates with rich men. Having worked her way up in Alamo's organization, Rue is sent on a special mission with Bishop. Meanwhile, Cassie's storybook wedding doesn't go as planned.

videos.title: Kitty Likes to Dance
videos.overview: Rue is offered a risky deal that draws her deeper into Alamo's world. While Nate battles the city council, Maddy gives Cassie a mission that could skyrocket her new career, and Lexi enlists Jules to create an original painting for LA Nights.

videos.title: This Little Piggy
videos.overview: She would never say it out loud, but Nate going broke finally granted Cassie permission to follow her dreams.

videos.title: Stand Still and See
videos.overview: Rue makes a deal with the devil in the form of a promise to Alamo...and gives a word of warning to Maddy. Later, Cassie gets her first real taste of stardom on the set of LA Nights, and Rue paints Jules a picture of her ideal future.

videos.title: Rain or Shine
videos.overview: Under intense financial pressure, Maddy schemes to get Cassie back in the spotlight. Meanwhile, Rue obsesses over the sign God gave her.

videos.title: In God We Trust
videos.overview: Danger closes in on all sides as Rue's double-dealing finally reaches its breaking point. While the medical van speeds towards the border, Maddy and Cassie must band together – and Alamo is struck by a life-changing epiphany.

awards: Won 9 Primetime Emmys. 42 wins & 105 nominations total
